shots.prompt: Wide shot. The woman lifts the sofa cushions one by one, searching, then says clearly: "Where is the remote?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu sitting on the sofa, deadpan. The dog says slowly in a deep calm male voice: "Did you look for it?" Then its mouth closes.
Medium shot. The woman throws her hands up and says: "I looked everywhere. Even the fridge."
shots.en: I looked everywhere. Even the fridge.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, one ear tilting. The dog says slowly in the deep voice: "The fridge?" Then its mouth closes and stays still while the studio audience laughs, and the laughter fades out before the shot ends.
The woman lies on the floor shining a small flashlight under the low TV cabinet. No dialogue. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays at the start, then fades to silence.
Close-up of the Shiba Inu on the sofa, deadpan. The dog says slowly in the deep voice: "Warmer." Then its mouth closes.
The woman stands up hopefully, walks toward the kitchen doorway and asks: "Over here?"

Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says slowly in the deep voice: "Colder. Much colder." Then its mouth closes and stays still while the studio audience laughs, and the laughter fades out before the shot ends.

Evening, the warm orange floor lamp glows. The woman drops onto the sofa next to the dog with a tired sigh. No dialogue. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass transition riff plays at the start, then fades to silence.
Medium shot. The woman leans back on the sofa and says: "Fine. No TV tonight. Let's just talk."
shots.en: Fine. No TV tonight. Let's just talk.
shots.ko: 됐어. 오늘은 TV 없어. 그냥 얘기나 하자.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the Shiba Inu, eyes widening slightly. The dog says in the deep voice: "I'll help you look." Then its mouth closes.
The Shiba Inu stands up on the sofa. A black TV remote is revealed on the cushion exactly where the dog was sitting. The woman stares at it, then says: "You were sitting on it?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, calm and deadpan. The dog says slowly in the deep voice: "It was warm. I kept it safe." Then its mouth closes.
shots.en: It was warm. I kept it safe.

shots.prompt: The woman picks up the remote and narrows her eyes at the dog: "For how long?"
Close-up of the Shiba Inu, deadpan. The dog says slowly in the deep voice: "Since Tuesday." Then its mouth closes and stays still while the studio audience bursts into laughter.

Wide shot. The woman and the dog sit side by side watching the boxy CRT TV. The dog slowly places one paw on the remote, mouths closed. The audience laughter turns into applause, then a short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass outro riff plays and fades out. No dialogue.
